policy_active.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_active.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_active.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_active.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

items.what_happened: A bill modifies property tax provisions in Utah.
items.effect: You must apply to the county for a residential property tax exemption if your property was ineligible in the prior year, an ownership interest changes, or the county believes the property no longer qualifies.

items.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
items.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.
